A juror that skips cases loses 32% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the sonnet fee to keep them eligible. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
